c002: Alexandria Leads course: from your first login to a team that sells
c003: 12 short lessons and 40 frequently asked questions. Take one lesson at a time and mark it as done. Your progress is saved in this browser.
c007: Log in and get to know Alexandria
c008: Open https://www.alexandrialeads.app, log in with your email and password, and take a look at the menu.
c010: Type your email and password and click Entrar (Log in). If you forgot your password, click Esqueci minha senha (Forgot my password).
c011: The menu is on the left: Dashboard, Leads, Conversas (Conversations), Espelho (Availability chart), Propostas (Proposals), Agenda (Calendar), Notas (Notes), Importar (Import), Check-in and Alertas (Alerts). Masters and managers also see Acesso (Access), Grupos (Groups) and other areas.
c012: On your phone, the menu opens with the button in the corner of the screen.
c013: To log out, use Sair (Log out) at the bottom of the menu.
c014: Tip: Alexandria is invitation-only. Your agency's master is the one who invites you.
c017: See how many leads you have and how they're divided up.
c019: The three cards at the top show the total leads, the held leads (kept aside outside service hours) and the leads received today.
c020: Right below, Leads por corretor (Leads per agent) shows how many leads each person on the team has.
c021: Tip: Held leads are leads that arrived outside service hours. They're released automatically.
c024: Follow each client from the first contact through to the sale.
c026: Each lead sits in a pipeline column: Novo (New), Em atendimento (In contact), Visita agendada (Showing scheduled), Proposta (Offer), Vendido (Sold) and Perdido (Lost).
c027: Tap a lead to open its history, the AI's qualification summary and the notes.
c028: To change the stage, use the lead's panel. When the client moves forward, move the lead to the next stage.
c029: Write a Nova nota / histórico (New note / history) entry every time you talk to the client. That way you won't forget any details.
c030: Tip: Keep the pipeline up to date. It's what shows you where the money is stuck.
c033: Ask the AI to write the first message to the client.
c035: Use the option to gerar mensagem (generate message) for the opening message.
c036: Read the text, tweak whatever you like and send it to the client on WhatsApp.
c037: After sending, add a note to the lead saying the first contact was made.
c038: Tip: The AI writes a draft. Always read it before you send.
c041: Bring a list of contacts into Alexandria.
c043: Choose the group that will receive the leads.
c044: Paste your spreadsheet in CSV format with the columns nome, telefone, email (name, phone, email).
c045: Confirm. The leads are distributed among the group's active agents.
c046: Tip: Only agents who are active in the group are included in the distribution.
c049: Set when the team receives leads and how they're distributed.
c051: Choose the group and set the service hours, day by day.
c052: Outside those hours, leads are held and released automatically when service starts again.
c053: New leads are distributed among the agents in rotation.
c054: Tip: Anyone who isn't available at that moment doesn't get new leads.
c057: Confirm you're on duty so you can receive leads.
c059: Allow the browser to use your location.
c060: Click to register. The system checks that you're at the duty location.
c061: Your check-in history appears on the same screen.
c062: Tip: If the browser asks for location permission, choose Allow.
c065: Add your people and organize the teams. Masters and managers only.
c066: Click Corretores (Agents) to add and invite the people who work with you.
c067: In Grupos (Groups), masters can create teams or agencies within the company.
c068: Each group has its own agents and service hours.
c069: On the Corretores screen, the master also decides whether the phone numbers of list leads are shown or protected.
c070: Tip: Invite people by email. They set their own password the first time they log in.
c073: Link your agency's number by scanning a QR code.
c074: Log in as master and open Master → WhatsApp.
c075: Click Conectar WhatsApp (Connect WhatsApp). A QR code appears in a few seconds.
c076: On the agency's phone, open WhatsApp, tap Linked devices, then Link a device.
c077: Point the camera at the QR code. The screen switches to Conectado (Connected) on its own.
c078: To switch numbers, click Desconectar (Disconnect) and connect again.
c079: Tip: Your clients' messages reach your team only, never another agency.
c082: Reply to clients right from Alexandria.
c084: You see the conversations for your leads. Masters and managers see the whole team's.
c085: Open a conversation, write your reply and send it.
c086: To reply from your browser, install the Mi Central extension and log in with the same email and password as Alexandria. Use the Número mãe (Main number) tab.
c087: List leads can only receive one first message. After that, only when the client replies. Each agent can send at most 20 first messages per day.
c088: Tip: These limits are there to protect the number from being blocked by WhatsApp.
c090: Calendar, notes, availability chart and proposals
c091: Keep showings, notes, units and negotiations organized.
c092: Agenda (Calendar): schedule showings. The reminder goes out on WhatsApp and is redone if you change the time.
c093: Notas (Notes): keep general notes for your routine.
c094: Espelho (Availability chart): see unit availability in real time, development by development.
c095: Propostas (Proposals): follow the negotiation: draft, sent, approved or declined.
c096: Alertas (Alerts): see system notices such as a new lead or a stalled lead.
c097: Tip: Schedule the showing in the calendar as soon as the client agrees. It makes a big difference to attendance.
c099: Master: access, integrations and new agencies
c100: Control who gets in and when, and connect other systems.
c101: Acesso (Access): choose whether agents and managers have time and internet restrictions. You can also open access for a few minutes. The master is never blocked.
c102: Integrações (Integrations): create tokens so websites and ads can send leads to Alexandria. You can deactivate a token at any time.
c103: Empresas (Companies; super admin): see all client agencies and generate an invitation code for a new agency.
c104: The new agency opens the invitation link, creates its account with the code and goes straight in as master, with a 7-day trial.
c105: Tip: The invitation code is valid for 7 days and can only be used once.
c107: I forgot my password. What do I do?
c108: On the login screen, click Esqueci minha senha (Forgot my password) and type your email. If the email doesn't arrive, ask your master or support for help.
c109: Do I need to install anything?
c110: No. Alexandria runs in your browser. The Mi Central extension is optional, for replying from Chrome.
c111: Can I use it on my phone?
c112: Yes. Open the same address in your phone's browser.
c113: How do I log in for the first time?
c114: You get an invitation by email from the master, set your password and you're in.
c115: I logged in and the screen has no leads. Is that normal?
c116: Yes, if no lead has come in for you yet. Check that the master has already added you as an active agent.
c118: Leads that arrived outside service hours. The system releases them automatically when service hours start again.
c119: How do I move a lead to another stage?
c120: Open the lead and use the stage panel to move it to the next one: New, In contact, Showing scheduled, Offer, Sold or Lost.
c121: Can the AI send messages on its own?
c122: The AI writes the draft of the opening message. You're the one who reads it and sends it.
c123: The AI message doesn't show up. What can I do?
c124: Try again in a few seconds. If it keeps happening, let the master or support know.
c125: How do I import a contact list?
c126: In Importar (Import), choose the group and paste the CSV spreadsheet with name, phone and email.
c127: Which columns does the spreadsheet need?
c128: Name, phone and email. The phone number must include the area code.
c130: The active agents of the group you chose, in rotation.
c131: Why can't I see the phone number of some leads?
c132: The master can protect the phone numbers of list leads. In that case you chat through Alexandria without seeing the number.
c134: The master and the manager, on the Horários (Hours) screen.
c136: New leads are distributed among the available agents. Whoever has checked in and is within service hours gets the lead.
c138: It confirms you're on duty. The system checks your location.
c140: Allow location access in your browser and try again, close to the duty location.
c141: How do I invite an agent?
c142: In Corretores (Agents), add the person with their email. They get the invitation and create their password.
c143: How do I create a group?
c144: In Grupos (Groups; master only), create the team and then add the agents to it.
c145: How do I connect my agency's WhatsApp?
c146: Master → WhatsApp → Conectar WhatsApp (Connect WhatsApp). Scan the QR code under Linked devices.
c147: The QR code doesn't show up.
c148: Wait a few seconds. If it doesn't appear, click Conectar (Connect) again or let support know.
c149: Can I connect more than one number?
c150: Right now each agency connects one number. To switch, disconnect and connect the new one.
c151: Can another agency see my messages?
c152: No. Messages are kept separate for each agency.
c153: Can I reply from my browser without opening Alexandria?
c154: Yes, with the Mi Central extension, on the Número mãe (Main number) tab, using the same login.
c155: Why can I only send one first message?
c156: It protects the number from being blocked. Once the client replies, the conversation is open.
c157: What's the daily limit for first messages?
c159: What is the sales availability chart?
c160: It's the list of available units in real time, development by development.
c161: How do I follow a proposal?
c162: On the Propostas (Proposals) screen: draft, sent, approved or declined.
c163: How do I schedule a showing?
c164: In the Agenda (Calendar). The reminder goes out on WhatsApp and follows any change of time.
c166: System notices, such as a new lead, a stalled lead and other important events.
c167: How do I open access outside the allowed hours?
c168: In Acesso (Access; master only), use Liberar por alguns minutos (Open for a few minutes).
c169: Do the access restrictions ever block the master?
c170: No. The master is never blocked.
c172: It's the key a website or ad uses to send leads to Alexandria. You'll find it in Integrações (Integrations).
c173: How do I deactivate a token?
c174: In Integrações, click Desativar (Deactivate). You can reactivate it later.
c175: How does a new agency get in?
c176: The super admin generates an invitation code under Empresas (Companies) and sends the link. The agency creates its account and enters as master.
c177: How long is the invitation code valid?
c178: 7 days, and it can only be used once.
c179: How long is a new agency's trial?
c181: Can I log in with Google?
c182: Not yet. For now you log in with email and password.
c184: Data is kept separate for each agency, and each person only sees what their role allows.
c185: Where do I ask for help?
c186: Talk to your agency's master or to Alexandria support.
